read_label_mapping: read a tab-delimited CSV file and return a dictionary mapping labels from one column to integer values in another
read_scene_types_mapping: read a tab-delimited text file and return a dictionary mapping scene type names to integer IDs
visualize_label_image: create a colorized visualization of a label segmentation numpy array and save it as an image file
visualize_instance_image: create a colorized visualization of an instance segmentation numpy array with unique colors per instance and save it
represents_int: check if a given string can be safely parsed as an integer and return a boolean result
